mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past quarter predicts a compression of long-term interest rates, enhancing equity valuation multiples and driving positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in the unemployment rate above 3.5% triggers a risk-off environment as investors anticipate weaker labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite UNRATE exceeding 3.5% in >60% of instances, or the t-statistic for the return difference is < -1.96 in a 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and growth in GDP (GDPC1) signals accommodative monetary policy and robust demand, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (FEDFUNDS decline * GDPC1 growth) shows no significant correlation with 20-day returns (p > 0.05) in a 10-year window, or the combined signal fails to predict returns in >70% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in the federal funds rate predicts reduced policy tightening pressures, fostering investor confidence and positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails to predict positive returns in >50% of late-cycle periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) against a baseline of no policy change.

mechanism_narrative: An upward deviation of INDPRO (industrial production) from its 2017=100 trend signals robust supply-side growth, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains below trend for >90% of the period, or 60-day returns are not significantly higher than a 5-year average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO crosses above 105 (its 2017=100 level), it indicates a strong supply-side recovery, prompting equity market optimism and positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The crossing does not precede positive 5-day returns in >60% of instances, or the returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) relative to a no-crossing baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 152,000 signals a strengthening labor market, attracting capital to equities and generating positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The payroll employment crossing fails to predict positive returns in >50% of triggered instances, or the returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) against a baseline of no crossing.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in the federal funds rate and inflation (CPIAUCSL) suggests deflationary pressures easing, reducing real interest rates and boosting equity valuations for positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The combined signal (FEDFUNDS decline * CPIAUCSL decline) shows no significant correlation with returns (p > 0.05) in a 5-year window, or the interaction effect fails to predict returns in >75% of cases.
